contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D N GRATIANVS PF AVG ; VRBS ROMA

A complete but broken into two fragments when found, Late Roman, struck or hammered silver siliqua coin of Emperor Gratian in the West (367-383AD). Obverse: Pearl diadem, draped and cuirassed bust right. Inscription: D N GRATIANVS PF AVG Reverse: Roma seated left, on throne, holding Victory on globe and resting on spear or sceptre. Inscription: VRBS ROMA. Mint mark: TRPS, Mint name: Trier. Die…
